name: tare
title_zh: 查清 Claude Code 额度去哪了的用量审计员
tagline_zh: 5 小时限额又爆了？别猜了。它逐条翻出 token 实际流向，定位是长任务拖垮、循环失控还是幽灵消耗。
tagline_en: Hit the 5-hour or weekly cap again? Stop guessing. It pinpoints runaway loops, phantom usage, or long tasks by.
desc_en: Diagnose Claude Code usage limits — find out where tokens actually went and why a 5-hour or weekly limit was hit. Use this whenever the user mentions hitting a usage limit, being rate limited, burning through their quota, running out of Claude Code usage, unexpected or suspicious token consumption, "why am I hitting limits", phantom usage, or asks to audit, analyze, or track their Claude Code toke
why_zh: 不只看总量，而是按会话、工具调用、时间轴拆解消耗，把「疑似异常」变成可指认的具体环节。
why_en: Breaks down consumption by session, tool, and timeline—turns vague 'suspicious usage' into a named culprit, no log-diving.
limit_zh: 只诊断 Claude Code 的用量数据，不优化代码、不调限额、不跨账号统计；需要本地有 CLI 日志权限。
limit_en: Diagnoses Claude Code usage only—no quota tweaks, no cross-account stats. Needs local CLI log access; covers official token records, not external.
title_en: Claude Code usage auditor that traces where tokens went
